Elena: Quick flag — Sapphire onboarding calls started getting 401s behind our edge proxy when we ramp preflight to ~40 concurrent devices.
Jorge: Hmm, which endpoint and region? Any customer logs?
Elena: EU region (eu-west-1). Root call is preflight /v1/preflight with ephemeral tokens. Snippet from edge logs:
```
[2026-03-20T15:12:41Z] svc=edge-proxy request_id=abc123 status=401 err="token: invalid scope" route=/v1/preflight client=20.1.2.3
```
Elena: Happening during initial device flood from their mobile beta fleet.
infra-bot: Alert: account:sapphire limited: account-preflight 429 window triggered at 2026-03-20T15:10Z
Devin: "invalid scope" suggests token claims not matching preflight required scope. Are they using ephemeral tokens from our auth service or a custom proxy?
Elena: They use our JS SDK v0.7.1 to mint ephemeral tokens via server-side /auth endpoint. Here's the mint call we saw:
```
POST /auth/mint
{ "sub": "device-<id>", "scope": "preflight" }
```
Jorge: SDK v0.7.1 had a regression where it drops the scope on short-lived tokens when jittering refreshes. Can you confirm SDK version on their edge? Also paste the Authorization header from the failed request (redact token body)
Elena: Header shows `Authorization: Bearer eyJ...` and token TTL: 30s. They have parallel init doing preflight for each device, TTL=30s, so many tokens overlap and sometimes arrive stale.
Amanda: Customer note: they're onboarding 2k devices over 10 minutes; want guidance asap to avoid renewal risk.
Devin: Short TTL + high parallelism = stampede. Immediate workaround: centralize preflight on server and cache token for 60s, or use single handshake per device group. Also add exponential backoff + jitter before retrying 401/429.
Elena: Implemented a quick proxy cache: token cached 45s, preflight batch to 5rps. After that we saw 200s for most calls but intermittent 429s for a 20-min window:
```
[2026-03-20T15:35:12Z] status=429 scope=account-preflight retry-after=12
```
Devin: Recommend patching SDK to v0.8.0 which fixes scope propagation and increases default token TTL to 90s for preflight flows. Patch plan:
- SDK hotfix release v0.7.1-rc2 -> v0.8.0
- update onboarding template to cache tokens server-side
- add client-side semaphore with jitter
Jorge: I'll open ENG-ONBOARD-477 with the hotfix and assign to @jorge for release. Can we also add a server-side rate-limit rule to smooth preflight spikes? infra-bot can you queue a temporary rule for account:sapphire
infra-bot: Rate-limit rule queued: account:sapphire preflight cap to 5r/s for 3 hours (rule id rl-9832)
Elena: Thanks — customer reported stability improving. I'll send a short enablement note with recommended SDK upgrade and the caching pattern. Amanda — can you confirm we have a renewal check-in scheduled after they finish ramping?
Amanda: Yep, renewal check-in set for 2026-04-02. I'll include the mitigation recap and ask for feedback on SDK dev experience :thumbsup:
Elena: Great, closing this triage. Filed follow-up doc and support ticket: CS-1289.
